tells.1: Even, interchangeable posts and a vague non-ending ('started with what we could').
tells.2: Stock sentimental frame: 'One of the lovely things about…' plus smooth filler ('Those visits helped us get here').
tells.3: Mechanical symmetry: 'every shelf, every table, every book' and 'Maybe… Maybe…'.
tells.5: Corporate opener ('special milestone') and a hollow cliché tweet that never actually says anything.
tells.6: Same 'One of the lovely things…' template, closed with a tidy maybe/maybe cadence.

reason: Version 4 sounds like an owner: a dry aside, a specific joke, and uneven warmth a person would actually post. The rest share a tidy six-beat anniversary template; 3 is the most mechanically symmetrical, and 5 is too thin and tangled to read as skilled.
